edges.label: Battelle's Air Force liaison for Blue Book-related work
edges.note: Cross was the named point of contact between Battelle's Stork analysts and Wright-Patterson.

edges.label: Author of the 9 January 1953 memorandum
edges.note: Two pages, reference G-1579-4, SECRET, unsigned, to Miles E. Goll at Wright-Patterson AFB.

edges.label: Discovered the memorandum in 1967 among Hynek's papers and named its author 'Pentacle'
edges.note: Journal entry 18 June 1967; published in Forbidden Science (1992). H. C. Cross was later identified as the author.

edges.label: Written five days before the panel met; per Vallee the panel was never briefed on its proposals
edges.note: Vallee's conclusion is that a separate group had already decided what the panel could and could not discuss - contractor-side predetermination of an official scientific review.

edges.label: Addressed to Miles E. Goll at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base
edges.note: No signed original has ever been produced by the Air Force or by Battelle.
